headline: Eighteen matches in, the LSC table is still empty, and conference play is 22 days away.
dek: Eighteen matches carry a published final score out of 151 on the season calendar. Three more are marked final with no score published, and two sit past their date with no result recorded.

summary_stat.label: Matches played
summary_stat.detail: Eighteen matches carry a published final score; the season calendar holds 151 in all.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Midwestern State has scored eleven goals in non-conference play, more than any two other programmes have scored together.

chart.caption: Goals scored against opponents from outside the conference, by programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three matches marked final without a published score are Lubbock Christian's — August 15, August 19 and August 22.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match carries a published result the collector could not read behind: Sul Ross State against CSU Pueblo on August 29, with no box-score link on any collected schedule page. It is not a silent final — the score is published, the shape of it is not.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against opponents from outside the conference the LSC programmes have won nine, drawn one and lost six, scoring 31 goals and conceding 26.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian has scored four goals in non-conference play and conceded none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eleven saves for Sul Ross State, more than any other keeper in the collected records.

last_match.line: West Alabama 0-2 Texas A&M International, the only match collected on August 31.

next_match.line: West Texas A&M away to Colorado Christian at 15:00, the only match on the day.

table_state.statement: No conference match has been played, so no programme has a conference record yet and the table carries early form from non-conference results only.
table_state.footnote: Conference play opens September 23, 22 days after this collection · eighteen matches are played and three finals carry no score, counted beside that figure and never inside it · friendlies sit outside the record entirely and are counted nowhere in it · a pre-conference table is a valid state.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
